# Agent Hub — OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT Coding-Agent Supervisor

Canonical repository: https://github.com/dzrdzrdzr/Agent-Hub
Project type: Open-source local daemon, CLI, and VS Code extension
License: MIT
Status: Alpha

## Summary

Agent Hub supervises long-running OpenAI Codex and Codex CLI workflows, including Codex profiles authenticated through ChatGPT, and Cline/DeepSeek executor jobs. It persists tasks, detects stalls, recovers processes after daemon restart, monitors training, packages results, and lets a planner delegate execution without keeping VS Code or SSH attached.

## Search aliases

- OpenAI Codex agent supervisor
- ChatGPT Codex long-running task manager
- keep Codex running after SSH disconnect
- Codex Cline DeepSeek orchestration
- AI coding-agent process watchdog
- Codex training-process monitor
- persistent Codex task daemon
- unattended coding-agent supervisor

## Main capabilities

- SQLite persistence for tasks, goals, events, transitions, and budgets.
- OpenAI Codex planner and Cline/DeepSeek executor orchestration.
- Stall detection, bounded retry, process-tree cancellation, and recovery.
- Training-process monitoring and result packaging.
- Local JSON-Lines IPC and stdlib-only CLI.
- VS Code sidebar for goals, tasks, live output, cancellation, and status.
- Mechanical monitoring without repeated planner-model calls.

## Installation

Clone the repository, create a Python 3.10+ virtual environment, and install: python -m pip install -e "./agentd[dev]". Use config.test.yaml for a deterministic mock demonstration, or generate config.local.yaml with agent-hub init.
